name: nc/collection-count
title: Collection count
description: Number of results of a nc/collection. Only inside nc/collection.
aiHints: Optional. content.text is the text with {count} or %d, for example "{count} events"; "{count} event|{count} events" picks the singular for 1; a text without placeholder gets the number in front. Only two forms; \\| is a literal |, %% a literal %. content.one is the text for exactly one result. Without content.text the label resultsLabel of nc/collection applies.
